 'functions',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('identity',p.oid::regprocedure::text,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'security_definer',p.prosecdef,'volatility',p.provolatile,'parallel',p.proparallel,'leakproof',p.proleakproof,'language',l.lanname,'config',p.proconfig,'acl',coalesce(p.proacl::text,''),'definition',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'definition_sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'UTF8')),'hex'),'public_execute',has_function_privilege('public',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),'runtime_execute',has_function_privilege('mixer_hosted_runtime',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),'writer_execute',has_function_privilege('mixer_hosted_domain_writer',p.oid,'EXECUTE')) ORDER BY p.oid::regprocedure::text) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang WHERE n.nspname='mixer_authz'),

 'runtime_owned_objects',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(x ORDER BY x),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT 'schema:'||nspname x FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspowner=(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='mixer_hosted_runtime') UNION ALL SELECT 'relation:'||oid::regclass::text FROM pg_class WHERE relowner=(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='mixer_hosted_runtime') UNION ALL SELECT 'function:'||oid::regprocedure::text FROM pg_proc WHERE proowner=(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='mixer_hosted_runtime') UNION ALL SELECT 'database:'||datname FROM pg_database WHERE datdba=(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='mixer_hosted_runtime')) objects),

mixer_authz.finite_uint(now_s,0,9007199254740991) OR now_s>=i.expires_at OR i.authentication_completed_at<now_s-45 OR i.authentication_completed_at>now_s+30 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'current time rejected' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;\n PERFORM mixer_authz.assert_transaction(x);\n SELECT array_agg(ROW(m.lifecycle_id,m.role,m.revision)::mixer_authz.membership_witness_v1 ORDER BY m.lifecycle_id) INTO members FROM (SELECT allm.* FROM (SELECT om.lifecycle_id,om.role,om.revision FROM mixer_authz.organization_memberships om WHERE om.principal_id=a.principal_id AND om.organization=t.organization AND om.project_binding='organization_wide' AND om.status='active' AND (om.not_before IS NULL OR om.not_before<=now_s) AND (om.expires_at IS NULL OR now_s<om.expires_at) SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'server_version',current_setting('server_version'),
 'schemas',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',nspname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(nspowner),'acl',coalesce(nspacl::text,'')) ORDER BY nspname) FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname='mixer_authz'),
 'roles',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',rolname,'login',rolcanlogin,'super',rolsuper,'bypass',rolbypassrls,'createdb',rolcreatedb,'createrole',rolcreaterole,'replication',rolreplication,'inherit',rolinherit) ORDER BY rolname) FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname LIKE 'mixer_hosted_%'),
 'memberships',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',pg_get_userbyid(roleid),'member',pg_get_userbyid(member),'admin',admin_option,'inherit',inherit_option,'set',set_option) ORDER BY roleid,member),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_auth_members WHERE pg_get_userbyid(roleid) LIKE 'mixer_hosted_%' OR pg_get_userbyid(member) LIKE 'mixer_hosted_%'),
 'database',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('name',datname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(datdba),'acl',coalesce(datacl::text,'')) FROM pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()),
 'tables',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',c.relname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),'rls',c.relrowsecurity,'force',c.relforcerowsecurity,'acl',coalesce(c.relacl::text,''),'columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'notnull',a.attnotnull,'acl',coalesce(a.attacl::text,''),'collation',CASE WHEN a.attcollation=0 THEN NULL ELSE a.attcollation::regcollation::text END) ORDER BY a.attnum) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=c.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped),'constraints',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',co.conname,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(co.oid,true)) ORDER BY co.conname) FROM pg_constraint co WHERE co.conrelid=c.oid),'indexes',(SELECT jsonb_agg(pg_get_indexdef(ix.indexrelid) ORDER BY ic.relname) FROM pg_index ix JOIN pg_class ic ON ic.oid=ix.indexrelid WHERE ix.indrelid=c.oid),'triggers',(SELECT jsonb_agg(pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true) ORDER BY t.tgname) FROM pg_trigger t WHERE t.tgrelid=c.oid AND NOT t.tgisinternal)) ORDER BY c.relname) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='mixer_authz' AND c.relkind='r'),
 'types',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',ty.typname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(ty.typowner),'acl',coalesce(ty.typacl::text,''),'fields',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod)) ORDER BY a.attnum) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=ty.typrelid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped)) ORDER BY ty.typname) FROM pg_type ty JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=ty.typnamespace JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=ty.typrelid WHERE n.nspname='mixer_authz' AND c.relkind='c'),
 'functions',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('identity',p.oid::regprocedure::text,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'security_definer',p.prosecdef,'volatility',p.provolatile,'parallel',p.proparallel,'leakproof',p.proleakproof,'language',l.lanname,'config',p.proconfig,'acl',coalesce(p.proacl::text,''),'definition',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'definition_sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'UTF8')),'hex'),'public_execute',has_function_privilege('public',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),'runtime_execute',has_function_privilege('mixer_hosted_runtime',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),'writer_execute',has_function_privilege('mixer_hosted_domain_writer',p.oid,'EXECUTE')) ORDER BY p.oid::regprocedure::text) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang WHERE n.nspname='mixer_authz'),
 'policies',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',tablename,'name',policyname,'permissive',permissive,'roles',roles,'command',cmd,'using',qual,'check',with_check) ORDER BY tablename,policyname) FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='mixer_authz'),
 'default_acl',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('owner',pg_get_userbyid(defaclrole),'schema',CASE WHEN defaclnamespace=0 THEN '' ELSE defaclnamespace::regnamespace::text END,'type',defaclobjtype,'acl',defaclacl::text) ORDER BY defaclobjtype),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_default_acl WHERE pg_get_userbyid(defaclrole)='mixer_hosted_schema_owner'),
 'runtime_owned_objects',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(x ORDER BY x),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT 'schema:'||nspname x FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspowner=(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='mixer_hosted_runtime') UNION ALL SELECT 'relation:'||oid::regclass::text FROM pg_class WHERE relowner=(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='mixer_hosted_runtime') UNION ALL SELECT 'function:'||oid::regprocedure::text FROM pg_proc WHERE proowner=(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='mixer_hosted_runtime') UNION ALL SELECT 'database:'||datname FROM pg_database WHERE datdba=(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='mixer_hosted_runtime')) objects),
 'runtime_creatable_schemas',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(nspname ORDER BY nspname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_namespace WHERE has_schema_privilege('mixer_hosted_runtime',oid,'CREATE')),
 'runtime_capabilities',jsonb_build_object('database_create',has_database_privilege('mixer_hosted_runtime',current_database(),'CREATE'),'database_temp',has_database_privilege('mixer_hosted_runtime',current_database(),'TEMP'),'public_create',has_schema_privilege('mixer_hosted_runtime','public','CREATE'),'authz_create',has_schema_privilege('mixer_hosted_runtime','mixer_authz','CREATE'),'reachable',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(rolname ORDER BY rolname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname<>'mixer_hosted_runtime' AND pg_has_role('mixer_hosted_runtime',oid,'MEMBER')))
);

SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'server_version',current_setting('server_version'),
 'schemas',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',nspname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(nspowner),'acl',coalesce(nspacl::text,'')) ORDER BY nspname) FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname='mixer_authz'),
 'roles',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',rolname,'login',rolcanlogin,'super',rolsuper,'bypass',rolbypassrls,'createdb',rolcreatedb,'createrole',rolcreaterole,'replication',rolreplication,'inherit',rolinherit) ORDER BY rolname) FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname LIKE 'mixer_hosted_%'),
 'memberships',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',pg_get_userbyid(roleid),'member',pg_get_userbyid(member),'admin',admin_option,'inherit',inherit_option,'set',set_option) ORDER BY roleid,member),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_auth_members WHERE pg_get_userbyid(roleid) LIKE 'mixer_hosted_%' OR pg_get_userbyid(member) LIKE 'mixer_hosted_%'),
 'database',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('name',datname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(datdba),'acl',coalesce(datacl::text,'')) FROM pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()),
 'tables',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',c.relname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),'rls',c.relrowsecurity,'force',c.relforcerowsecurity,'acl',coalesce(c.relacl::text,''),'columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'notnull',a.attnotnull,'acl',coalesce(a.attacl::text,''),'collation',CASE WHEN a.attcollation=0 THEN NULL ELSE a.attcollation::regcollation::text END) ORDER BY a.attnum) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=c.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped),'constraints',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',co.conname,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(co.oid,true)) ORDER BY co.conname) FROM pg_constraint co WHERE co.conrelid=c.oid),'indexes',(SELECT jsonb_agg(pg_get_indexdef(ix.indexrelid) ORDER BY ic.relname) FROM pg_index ix JOIN pg_class ic ON ic.oid=ix.indexrelid WHERE ix.indrelid=c.oid),'triggers',(SELECT jsonb_agg(pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true) ORDER BY t.tgname) FROM pg_trigger t WHERE t.tgrelid=c.oid AND NOT t.tgisinternal)) ORDER BY c.relname) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='mixer_authz' AND c.relkind='r'),
 'types',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',ty.typname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(ty.typowner),'acl',coalesce(ty.typacl::text,''),'fields',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod)) ORDER BY a.attnum) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=ty.typrelid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped)) ORDER BY ty.typname) FROM pg_type ty JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=ty.typnamespace JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=ty.typrelid WHERE n.nspname='mixer_authz' AND c.relkind='c'),
 'functions',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('identity',p.oid::regprocedure::text,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'security_definer',p.prosecdef,'volatility',p.provolatile,'parallel',p.proparallel,'leakproof',p.proleakproof,'language',l.lanname,'config',p.proconfig,'acl',coalesce(p.proacl::text,''),'definition',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'definition_sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'UTF8')),'hex'),'public_execute',has_function_privilege('public',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),'runtime_execute',has_function_privilege('mixer_hosted_runtime',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),'writer_execute',has_function_privilege('mixer_hosted_domain_writer',p.oid,'EXECUTE')) ORDER BY p.oid::regprocedure::text) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang WHERE n.nspname='mixer_authz'),
 'policies',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',tablename,'name',policyname,'permissive',permissive,'roles',roles,'command',cmd,'using',qual,'check',with_check) ORDER BY tablename,policyname) FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='mixer_authz'),
 'default_acl',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('owner',pg_get_userbyid(defaclrole),'schema',CASE WHEN defaclnamespace=0 THEN '' ELSE defaclnamespace::regnamespace::text END,'type',defaclobjtype,'acl',defaclacl::text) ORDER BY defaclobjtype),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_default_acl WHERE pg_get_userbyid(defaclrole)='mixer_hosted_schema_owner'),
 'runtime_owned_objects',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(x ORDER BY x),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT 'schema:'||nspname x FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspowner=(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='mixer_hosted_runtime') UNION ALL SELECT 'relation:'||oid::regclass::text FROM pg_class WHERE relowner=(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='mixer_hosted_runtime') UNION ALL SELECT 'function:'||oid::regprocedure::text FROM pg_proc WHERE proowner=(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='mixer_hosted_runtime') UNION ALL SELECT 'database:'||datname FROM pg_database WHERE datdba=(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='mixer_hosted_runtime')) objects),
 'runtime_creatable_schemas',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(nspname ORDER BY nspname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_namespace WHERE has_schema_privilege('mixer_hosted_runtime',oid,'CREATE')),
 'runtime_capabilities',jsonb_build_object('database_create',has_database_privilege('mixer_hosted_runtime',current_database(),'CREATE'),'database_temp',has_database_privilege('mixer_hosted_runtime',current_database(),'TEMP'),'public_create',has_schema_privilege('mixer_hosted_runtime','public','CREATE'),'authz_create',has_schema_privilege('mixer_hosted_runtime','mixer_authz','CREATE'),'reachable',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(rolname ORDER BY rolname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname<>'mixer_hosted_runtime' AND pg_has_role('mixer_hosted_runtime',oid,'MEMBER')))
);

 'schemas',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',nspname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(nspowner),'acl',coalesce(nspacl::text,'')) ORDER BY nspname) FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname='mixer_authz'),
 'roles',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',rolname,'login',rolcanlogin,'super',rolsuper,'bypass',rolbypassrls,'createdb',rolcreatedb,'createrole',rolcreaterole,'replication',rolreplication,'inherit',rolinherit) ORDER BY rolname) FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname LIKE 'mixer_hosted_%'),
 'memberships',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',pg_get_userbyid(roleid),'member',pg_get_userbyid(member),'admin',admin_option,'inherit',inherit_option,'set',set_option) ORDER BY roleid,member),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_auth_members WHERE pg_get_userbyid(roleid) LIKE 'mixer_hosted_%' OR pg_get_userbyid(member) LIKE 'mixer_hosted_%'),
 'database',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('name',datname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(datdba),'acl',coalesce(datacl::text,'')) FROM pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()),
 'tables',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',c.relname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),'rls',c.relrowsecurity,'force',c.relforcerowsecurity,'acl',coalesce(c.relacl::text,''),'columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'notnull',a.attnotnull,'acl',coalesce(a.attacl::text,''),'collation',CASE WHEN a.attcollation=0 THEN NULL ELSE a.attcollation::regcollation::text END) ORDER BY a.attnum) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=c.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped),'constraints',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',co.conname,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(co.oid,true)) ORDER BY co.conname) FROM pg_constraint co WHERE co.conrelid=c.oid),'indexes',(SELECT jsonb_agg(pg_get_indexdef(ix.indexrelid) ORDER BY ic.relname) FROM pg_index ix JOIN pg_class ic ON ic.oid=ix.indexrelid WHERE ix.indrelid=c.oid),'triggers',(SELECT jsonb_agg(pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true) ORDER BY t.tgname) FROM pg_trigger t WHERE t.tgrelid=c.oid AND NOT t.tgisinternal)) ORDER BY c.relname) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='mixer_authz' AND c.relkind='r'),
 'types',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',ty.typname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(ty.typowner),'acl',coalesce(ty.typacl::text,''),'fields',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod)) ORDER BY a.attnum) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=ty.typrelid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped)) ORDER BY ty.typname) FROM pg_type ty JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=ty.typnamespace JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=ty.typrelid WHERE n.nspname='mixer_authz' AND c.relkind='c'),
 'functions',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('identity',p.oid::regprocedure::text,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'security_definer',p.prosecdef,'volatility',p.provolatile,'parallel',p.proparallel,'leakproof',p.proleakproof,'language',l.lanname,'config',p.proconfig,'acl',coalesce(p.proacl::text,''),'definition',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'definition_sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'UTF8')),'hex'),'public_execute',has_function_privilege('public',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),'runtime_execute',has_function_privilege('mixer_hosted_runtime',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),'writer_execute',has_function_privilege('mixer_hosted_domain_writer',p.oid,'EXECUTE')) ORDER BY p.oid::regprocedure::text) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang WHERE n.nspname='mixer_authz'),
 'policies',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',tablename,'name',policyname,'permissive',permissive,'roles',roles,'command',cmd,'using',qual,'check',with_check) ORDER BY tablename,policyname) FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='mixer_authz'),
 'default_acl',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('owner',pg_get_userbyid(defaclrole),'schema',CASE WHEN defaclnamespace=0 THEN '' ELSE defaclnamespace::regnamespace::text END,'type',defaclobjtype,'acl',defaclacl::text) ORDER BY defaclobjtype),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_default_acl WHERE pg_get_userbyid(defaclrole)='mixer_hosted_schema_owner'),
 'runtime_owned_objects',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(x ORDER BY x),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT 'schema:'||nspname x FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspowner=(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='mixer_hosted_runtime') UNION ALL SELECT 'relation:'||oid::regclass::text FROM pg_class WHERE relowner=(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='mixer_hosted_runtime') UNION ALL SELECT 'function:'||oid::regprocedure::text FROM pg_proc WHERE proowner=(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='mixer_hosted_runtime') UNION ALL SELECT 'database:'||datname FROM pg_database WHERE datdba=(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='mixer_hosted_runtime')) objects),
 'runtime_creatable_schemas',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(nspname ORDER BY nspname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_namespace WHERE has_schema_privilege('mixer_hosted_runtime',oid,'CREATE')),
 'runtime_capabilities',jsonb_build_object('database_create',has_database_privilege('mixer_hosted_runtime',current_database(),'CREATE'),'database_temp',has_database_privilege('mixer_hosted_runtime',current_database(),'TEMP'),'public_create',has_schema_privilege('mixer_hosted_runtime','public','CREATE'),'authz_create',has_schema_privilege('mixer_hosted_runtime','mixer_authz','CREATE'),'reachable',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(rolname ORDER BY rolname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname<>'mixer_hosted_runtime' AND pg_has_role('mixer_hosted_runtime',oid,'MEMBER')))
);

 'server_version',current_setting('server_version'),
 'schemas',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',nspname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(nspowner),'acl',coalesce(nspacl::text,'')) ORDER BY nspname) FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname='mixer_authz'),
 'roles',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',rolname,'login',rolcanlogin,'super',rolsuper,'bypass',rolbypassrls,'createdb',rolcreatedb,'createrole',rolcreaterole,'replication',rolreplication,'inherit',rolinherit) ORDER BY rolname) FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname LIKE 'mixer_hosted_%'),
 'memberships',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',pg_get_userbyid(roleid),'member',pg_get_userbyid(member),'admin',admin_option,'inherit',inherit_option,'set',set_option) ORDER BY roleid,member),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_auth_members WHERE pg_get_userbyid(roleid) LIKE 'mixer_hosted_%' OR pg_get_userbyid(member) LIKE 'mixer_hosted_%'),
 'database',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('name',datname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(datdba),'acl',coalesce(datacl::text,'')) FROM pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()),
 'tables',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',c.relname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),'rls',c.relrowsecurity,'force',c.relforcerowsecurity,'acl',coalesce(c.relacl::text,''),'columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'notnull',a.attnotnull,'acl',coalesce(a.attacl::text,''),'collation',CASE WHEN a.attcollation=0 THEN NULL ELSE a.attcollation::regcollation::text END) ORDER BY a.attnum) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=c.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped),'constraints',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',co.conname,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(co.oid,true)) ORDER BY co.conname) FROM pg_constraint co WHERE co.conrelid=c.oid),'indexes',(SELECT jsonb_agg(pg_get_indexdef(ix.indexrelid) ORDER BY ic.relname) FROM pg_index ix JOIN pg_class ic ON ic.oid=ix.indexrelid WHERE ix.indrelid=c.oid),'triggers',(SELECT jsonb_agg(pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true) ORDER BY t.tgname) FROM pg_trigger t WHERE t.tgrelid=c.oid AND NOT t.tgisinternal)) ORDER BY c.relname) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='mixer_authz' AND c.relkind='r'),
 'types',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',ty.typname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(ty.typowner),'acl',coalesce(ty.typacl::text,''),'fields',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod)) ORDER BY a.attnum) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=ty.typrelid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped)) ORDER BY ty.typname) FROM pg_type ty JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=ty.typnamespace JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=ty.typrelid WHERE n.nspname='mixer_authz' AND c.relkind='c'),
 'functions',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('identity',p.oid::regprocedure::text,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'security_definer',p.prosecdef,'volatility',p.provolatile,'parallel',p.proparallel,'leakproof',p.proleakproof,'language',l.lanname,'config',p.proconfig,'acl',coalesce(p.proacl::text,''),'definition',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'definition_sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'UTF8')),'hex'),'public_execute',has_function_privilege('public',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),'runtime_execute',has_function_privilege('mixer_hosted_runtime',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),'writer_execute',has_function_privilege('mixer_hosted_domain_writer',p.oid,'EXECUTE')) ORDER BY p.oid::regprocedure::text) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang WHERE n.nspname='mixer_authz'),
 'policies',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',tablename,'name',policyname,'permissive',permissive,'roles',roles,'command',cmd,'using',qual,'check',with_check) ORDER BY tablename,policyname) FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='mixer_authz'),
 'default_acl',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('owner',pg_get_userbyid(defaclrole),'schema',CASE WHEN defaclnamespace=0 THEN '' ELSE defaclnamespace::regnamespace::text END,'type',defaclobjtype,'acl',defaclacl::text) ORDER BY defaclobjtype),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_default_acl WHERE pg_get_userbyid(defaclrole)='mixer_hosted_schema_owner'),
 'runtime_owned_objects',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(x ORDER BY x),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT 'schema:'||nspname x FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspowner=(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='mixer_hosted_runtime') UNION ALL SELECT 'relation:'||oid::regclass::text FROM pg_class WHERE relowner=(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='mixer_hosted_runtime') UNION ALL SELECT 'function:'||oid::regprocedure::text FROM pg_proc WHERE proowner=(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='mixer_hosted_runtime') UNION ALL SELECT 'database:'||datname FROM pg_database WHERE datdba=(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='mixer_hosted_runtime')) objects),
 'runtime_creatable_schemas',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(nspname ORDER BY nspname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_namespace WHERE has_schema_privilege('mixer_hosted_runtime',oid,'CREATE')),
 'runtime_capabilities',jsonb_build_object('database_create',has_database_privilege('mixer_hosted_runtime',current_database(),'CREATE'),'database_temp',has_database_privilege('mixer_hosted_runtime',current_database(),'TEMP'),'public_create',has_schema_privilege('mixer_hosted_runtime','public','CREATE'),'authz_create',has_schema_privilege('mixer_hosted_runtime','mixer_authz','CREATE'),'reachable',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(rolname ORDER BY rolname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname<>'mixer_hosted_runtime' AND pg_has_role('mixer_hosted_runtime',oid,'MEMBER')))
);
